brief:
Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year's olive harvest in the occupied West Bank, more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs reported Friday. The surge in violence has disrupted farming operations across the territory during the critical harvest period.

The United Nations has urged Israel to protect Palestinian farmers and their livelihoods amid the escalating attacks by settlers on agricultural communities.
dek: Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year’s olive harvest in the occupied West Bank – more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs said on Friday.
title: Settlers launch record 400 attacks on West Bank olive harvest
